crossRefs.note: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all…
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you…
You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make…
Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you…
They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

parallels.note: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

translations.web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”
translations.bsb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’”
translations.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
translations.asv: And if any one say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye, The Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him back hither.
